software.engine_image: qwen3-engine:25.10 (rebuilt 2026-07-06 with the optimization commits below)
engine_optimizations_included: ff8dc4f feat(export): CP 15-stage unroll keeps KV cache (~3x decode compute reduction)
c9c63c2 perf(engine): CUDA-graph decode replay (eliminates ~2700 kernel launches/step of CPU cost)
dd647be fix(engine): batch KV gather arena-ized (removes up-to-7.5GiB transient allocation per eager decode step)
d5741b6 fix(triton): ServerTimingAccumulator wiring + end->done terminal event unification

model.note: Full-bf16 engine. cp=bf16 validated hallucination-free on the internal 0701 checkpoint (0/100 deterministic probe; see docs/dev/investigation/streaming_hallucination.md). The engine was re-probed 0/100 after the CP-KV/CUDA-graph optimizations.

engine_profile.note: batch=128 selected automatically by the export-aware profile sizing (raw capacity ~141 lanes on this 32GiB card). The batch profile is a TEST VARIABLE, not a hardware ceiling -- see the report's 'Batch profile as a variable' section.

benchmark_request.speaker: Serena
benchmark_request.text: 你好，欢迎使用 Qwen3-TTS 语音合成系统，这是一段用于压测的示例文本。
benchmark_request.note: Fixed text/speaker across every request: isolates protocol/concurrency effects, and pins the run to a ~100% prefix-cache-hit regime (verified: cache_hit=True on 100% of measured rows). All prefill numbers are cache-hit (suffix-only) prefill.

isolation.policy: single-service: Triton container stopped during engine-path trials, engine container stopped during Triton trials
isolation.why: at batch=128 the engine alone holds ~29-30 GiB; the two services cannot coexist on this card, and co-residency would contaminate memory headroom and timing

tooling.harness: tools/validation/perf_matrix_sdk.py (built on the qwen3tts client SDK)

server_ttft_single_stream_warm_ms.basis: server_session_create_to_first_raw_audio_ms from the done-event meta (same basis as the historical '13ms' claim)
